import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes for all features
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] != 'clinical':  # Skip clinical for this analysis
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i].mean()
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i].mean()
            effect_size = abs(y1 - y0)
            effect_sizes.append((i, effect_size, fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    effect_sizes.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features
    top_features = effect_sizes[:10] if len(effect_sizes) > 10 else effect_sizes
    
    if len(top_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Get indices and feature IDs
    top_indices = [f[0] for f in top_features]
    top_fids = [f[2] for f in top_features]
    
    # Check for near-duplicates (correlation >= 0.6)
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, top_indices].T)
    np.fill_diagonal(corr_matrix, 0)
    
    # Remove highly correlated features (keep one from each pair)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(top_indices)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_indices)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(j)
    
    # Final feature set after removing duplicates
    final_features = [top_fids[i] for i in range(len(top_fids)) if i not in to_remove]
    
    if len(final_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select the strongest feature as driver
    strongest_fid = top_fids[0] if top_fids[0] in final_features else final_features[0]
    
    # Create weighted score from remaining features
    weights = np.ones(len(final_features)) / len(final_features)
    
    return Design(
        drivers=(strongest_fid,),
        columns=tuple(final_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(final_features, weights))
    )
